L44: # Procedure
L45:   * “How soon can I get credit for an On-Demand Course?”
L46:     * 3 and 4 credit on-demand courses will become available to add to your transcript 6 weeks after enrollment.
L47:     * 2 credit courses will become available to add to your transcript after 4 weeks.
L48:     * 1 credit courses will become available to add to your transcript after 2 weeks.
L49:   * “During which session will an On-Demand course appear on my transcript?”
L50:     * An on-demand course will appear on your transcript in the session you complete the course. Course attendance dates will be listed on your transcript.
L51:     * If you are on the cusp of two sessions and need to confirm the date of completion or beginning/end of a session, please contact our support team at ulcourses@asu.edu.

L52: # Institutions Accepting ASU Universal Learner Transfer Credits
L53:   1. Will my college or university accept credits earned through ASU Universal Learner Courses?
L54:     1. Credits earned through Arizona State University (ASU) Universal Learner Courses (ULC) are widely accepted at many colleges and universities. However, transfer credit policies vary by institution. We strongly recommend contacting your college or university directly to confirm how these credits will transfer and apply to your specific program of study.
